description: Explain why a field is what it is: returns the recent derivation/constraint trace records for a path from the in-memory ring buffer (inputs, expression, result). For a constraint use the synthetic path "$constraint:<id>". Trace records can be bulky — pass 'limit' to return only the most recent N.

limit.description: Optional cap; return only the most recent N trace records.

path.description: A canonical JSON Path address, e.g. "$.order.total".

name: explain
title: Explain field
